La Crème Wedding Cakes

$7 guest

Wedding and anniversary cakes for Nashville and Middle Tennessee, by appointment in Murfreesboro. Starting prices cover simple decoration and two cake flavors.

Minimum order is $400. Groom's cakes start at $400. Wedding cupcakes start at $4.50 each, and a top-tier cake with a cupcake order is $65. Sheet cakes are listed at $225 for 50 servings and $450 for 100 servings. Phone 615-530-7850. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published

113 Taborwood Trail, Murfreesboro, TN 37127
